mood: The calling card: a lone lantern-tune in the dark explodes into a heroic minor adventure anthem; the Long Dusk, and the journey rising against it.
core_styles: cutting bright pulse-wave lead with wide leaping melody
full driving drums with tom fills and crash cymbals

sections.name: Title Fanfare
sections.text: {at full volume on beat one: crash, timpani and a bold brass fanfare on the theme's rising first notes, then straight into the anthem}
styles: bold fanfare from the very first beat

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the heroic A minor anthem: a wide leaping lead melody over the galloping bass and brass stabs, Am F G chords with a dramatic E major dominant, bold and memorable}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the anthem again, a second lead harmonising and the pulse arpeggio racing, fuller and higher}

sections.name: Triumphant Lift
sections.text: {contrast: a circle-of-fifths climb D minor, G, C, F up to a triumphant C major peak, the lead soaring to its highest notes, crash cymbals, the sense of a whole journey ahead}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the heroic minor anthem returns; the last bar slams on the E major dominant straight back into the main theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
